items.heading: Fenkata
details: Key ingredients: rabbit, garlic, wine, bay leaf
Marinate rabbit pieces in wine, garlic and bay leaf.
Fry the rabbit until browned on all sides.
Simmer in the marinade until the meat is tender.
Serve with pasta or fried potatoes as a first course, then the meat.

items.heading: Pastizzi
details: Key ingredients: flaky pastry, ricotta or peas, egg
Layer and fold pastry dough to create many flaky layers.
Fill with a mixture of ricotta or mashed peas.
Shape into small pointed parcels.
Bake until puffed and golden brown.
